description: Case seed for the Aït Bouguemez grazing case: the frozen analysis geometry, the validated bundle catalog and the corpus manifest. The seed loader maps these into the case record; this file asserts no measured result and no field visit.

case.title: Grazing and livelihoods in the Aït Bouguemez valley
case.objective: Is grazing changing the shared pastures of the Aït Bouguemez valley?
case.description: Reported: concern about grazing pressure on shared pastures. Not established: whether vegetation has changed, or why.
unresolvedQuestions: Whether vegetation has changed, or why.

geoSelection.label: Valley catchment (hydrological analysis extent), not a pasture, agdal or management boundary

geometry.sameAs: analysis-geometry.geojson in every bundle of data/bundles/ (byte-identical)

geoSelection.areaMethod: Geodesic area of the frozen polygon on the WGS84 ellipsoid (pyproj Geod), 417,044,860.5 m²; published as 417.04 km² in docs/reference/data-sources-and-methods.md#study-area
geoSelection.selectionMethod: Native 30 m delineation from Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (2021 release) upstream of a fixed outlet; method and acceptance checks in docs/reference/data-sources-and-methods.md#study-area
limitations: A hydrological analysis extent, not a pasture, agdal, administrative or management boundary.
